2611.17394.image_caption: Figure 1: Agentic-Teacher pipeline. Given a VLA checkpoint, simulation environment, and task interface, a coding agent uses the harness to evaluate the VLA under varied initial conditions and diagnose failures by comparing successful and failed rollouts. It invokes perception and control tools to synthesize and validate closed-loop code policies that generate corrective demonstrations from VLA failure states. Demonstrations from reliable repair experts are processed through action noise injection, idle-frame removal, and filtering based on the frozen base model’s flow-matching loss, and then combined with successful VLA trajectories to construct the VLA fine-tuning dataset.

2611.17539.image_caption: Figure 1: pXRD structure determination as a verifiable inverse problem. Ground truth: pXRD-Bench case pxrd100-rep-010 . Proposed: pxrd-codex selected.cif . Structures rendered with Crystal Toolkit ( Horton et al., 2023 ) .

2611.17790.image_caption: Figure 1: AutoRL: autonomous RL supervision and research. Right: AutoRL continually adopts interventions, such as fixes and adjustments, to sustain gains over a static recipe.

2611.17814.image_caption: Figure 1: G-CAST, a governed continual adaptation loop for deployed e-commerce agents. The main self-evolution loop converts daily production queries into checkpoint updates through multi-rollout generation, reward reliability checking, reward-routed data orchestration, model adaptation, and governed checkpoint transition. When rollout evidence indicates a possible reward error under the current contract, the reward-evolution loop updates the executable reward through contract-grounded annotation, offline reward checks, and trial adaptation before training resumes. Candidate checkpoints are admitted only after cumulative evaluation on both newly introduced and previously retained capabilities, with rejected candidates, regressions, and reward anomalies recorded in the evaluation ledger.

2611.18006.image_caption: Figure 1 : Overview of the proposed RecurIR framework. Top: A general agentic image restoration pipeline. Bottom: The proposed recursive self-improvement framework, consisting of policy-hypothesis discovery (PDM), rule-falsification-driven task evolution (RTEM), and change-conditioned policy revision (CPRM).

2611.18176.image_caption: Figure 1 : The ESI collect–learn flywheel. Within each episode, the LLM plans and reviews, the VLA proposes actions, and teacher corrections create states from which the VLA continues. The shared experience record links local intent, control source, and local execution outcomes. After each collection round, experience informs prompt and skill refinement, while retained effective actions provide VLA training data. The three updated components are deployed together in the next round; LLM weights remain fixed.

2611.17524.image_caption: Fig. 3: Top-1 gain of model annealing over (a) cross-entropy and (b) snapshot distillation, per configuration.

2611.17529.image_caption: Fig. 2: World-model training. Frozen I-JEPA encodes the current and next images. The action-conditioned world model predicts the next visual embeddings and proprioceptive state, which are compared with the observed targets.

2611.17788.image_caption: Fig. 1 : Conceptual illustration of the FGO-inspired search dynamics in RAG-FGO. Hyphae grow from low-efficiency (info-sparse) zones toward high-efficiency (info-rich) zones in the retrieval space. (i) Local search enables fine-grained exploitation within promising regions; (ii) global search facilitates large semantic jumps to escape local optima and discover new resource-rich areas.

2611.17808.image_caption: Figure 1: CarryOn: carry what matters. Left: Context-management challenges and CarryOn’s separation of compact task state from fine-grained evidence. Right: Success–efficiency comparison (top) and task-success gains over the strongest baseline, averaged by benchmark or Actor (bottom).

2611.18235.image_caption: Figure 1. A shared LLM researcher connects Web scientific knowledge with experiments to discover domain-specific forecasters and retain reusable research resources. The figure contrasts an LLM-enhanced forecasting system with an LLM researcher that connects dataset profiling, literature retrieval, hypotheses, model construction, experiments, and reflection. Persistent memory retains scientific knowledge, experimental experience, and modeling assets.

2611.18338.image_caption: Figure 2: HARE construction with a live example that combines structural changes and shared joins.

2611.17395.image_caption: Figure 1: Backdoor insertion via LLM-assisted weight-space programming. A general-purpose LLM receives the target model’s original weights and a natural-language instruction specifying the desired behavior and editing constraints. It returns modified model weights for independent evaluation.

2611.17621.image_caption: Figure 1: Architecture of AscendForge, integrating resource orchestration, kernel execution, evaluation and feedback, and deployment management for Ascend kernel optimization.

2611.17632.image_note: All nine PDF pages inspected. The paper contains text and numbered tables, with no numbered figure. One explicit card placeholder is retained.

2611.17806.image_caption: Figure 1 . A session-rekindling scenario where the scheduled May 6 health check has passed by the June 5 follow-up, contrasting stale preparation advice with an appropriate clarifying response. A timeline figure: an earlier session books a May~6 health check, the user returns on June~5 asking how to plan the evening, and two contrasting responses appear side by side—stale preparation advice and a clarifying question about whether the appointment took place.
